Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V0-D-sithfury-2022-E1mark-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V0-D-sithfury-PC-E1.gif]], 12 May 2020) → [[File:V0-D-sithfury-2022-E1mark-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V0-D-sithfury-2022-E1mark.png]], 31 July 2022). '''Errata mark:''' the image prints “E1”, but this is errata 2 in release order; the mark is recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[Sith Fury (V)]]): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-sf022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/sithfury.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Dark/large/sithfury.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier, in Virtual Set 0, and no earlier copy of its text was found). Document: no errata mark; the bottom margin prints “•Sith Fury” (with the uniqueness dot). Text: “USED: If you just drew a character for destiny, take that card into hand to cancel and redraw that destiny. LOST: Once per game, use 4 Force to [download] a Dark Jedi.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Sith Fury (V) (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 12 May 2020<ref name="img-sfa5142dd">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/sithfury.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a5142dd7418713cff839446994555bb787c156b4 commit a5142dd] (12 May 2020); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Dark/large/sithfury.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). Document: errata mark “E” bottom right; margin “Sith Fury” (no dot). Text: “USED: If you just drew a character for destiny, take that card into hand to cancel and redraw that destiny. LOST: Once per game, exchange a Dark Jedi in hand with a Dark Jedi in Lost Pile.”
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): PC card image uploaded 31 July 2022<ref name="img-sfab74419">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/sithfury.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ab7441976d996222d5b7235219576492a00bd1e2 commit ab74419] (31 July 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Dark/large/sithfury.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). LOST: Once per game, exchange a Dark Jedi in hand with a Dark Jedi in Lost Pile.”
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Sith Fury (V) (Errata 3)]]): PC card image uploaded 12 December 2022<ref name="img-sf12d0bca">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/sithfury.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/12d0bca60d8b85645ae7a6604003ce24123ce97c commit 12d0bca] (12 December 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Dark/large/sithfury.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). '''What changed:''' USED now offers a choice: take that card into hand, or cancel and redraw that destiny (before, the card was taken into hand to cancel and redraw); LOST is now “use 4 Force to take a character into hand from Lost Pile” (any character, not a Dark Jedi exchange). It is the current text (same file as the wiki's existing image). Document: mark “E2”. Text: “USED: If you just drew a character for destiny, choose: Take that card into hand. OR Cancel and redraw that destiny. LOST: Once per game, use 4 Force to take a character into hand from Lost Pile.”
